table.name: TLGNC_ORDER_OUTPUTDOC
table.description: Output Documents (Delivery Notes for now, only) belonging to an order. The newest version of a type is the 'current' version, older versions are kept to track important changes. E.g. the document was originally printed and signed by the customer must be kept. Technical limitation: Only Postscript can be sent to a printer, but it's currently not possible to generate PS out of PDF, therefore both types are always generated together, based on the same input data.

column.name: ORDER_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_order. The Order to which the Output Document belongs.

column.name: PDF_OUTPUTDOC_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_outputdoc. The generated output document of this order in PDF format. The PDF is generated in the language of the Ship-to.

column.name: PS_OUTPUTDOC_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_outputdoc. The generated output document of this order in PS format. For technical reasons, the PS is generated at the same time as the PDF, and can not be generated only when needed (before sending to printer). If this becomes possible, attribute could be removed, and the printing function modified to generate PS from the PDF on the fly.

column.name: GENERATED_IN_ORDER_STATUS_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_order_status_bs. Status of the order at the time the output document was generated. Used only for informational purposes, to show more meaningful information in the UI instead of only date/time. Several versions of the delivery note to the same order in the same status can exist!
